'''Andres Kollist''' (born 30 January 1948 in [[Tartu]]) is an [[Estonia]]n chemist, librarian, politician and activist.<ref name="entsyklopeedia.ee">{{cite web |title=Kollist, Andres - Eesti Entsüklopeedia |url=http://entsyklopeedia.ee/artikkel/kollist_andres1 |website=entsyklopeedia.ee |access-date=30 June 2021}}</ref>

In 1971 he graduated from [[Tartu State University]] in chemistry. After graduating he worked at [[Estonian SSR Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="entsyklopeedia.ee" />

His main field of research has been polygalactanes in [[red algae]].<ref name="entsyklopeedia.ee" />

1989-1993 and since 2008 he is a member of [[Tallinn City Council]]. 1995-2000 he was the CEO of [[Citizenship and Migration Board (Estonia)|Citizenship and Migration Board]]. 2000-2001 he was the rector of Audentes Higher Business School ({{Langx|et|Audentese Kõrgem Ärikool}}). Since 2004 he is the head of [[Tallinn University Academic Library]].<ref name="entsyklopeedia.ee" />

Awards:
* 2001: [[Order of the White Star]], V class.<ref name="president.ee">{{cite web |title=Teenetemärkide kavalerid: Andres Kollist|url=https://www.president.ee/et/vabariik/teenetemargid/kavaler/3626/andres-kollist |website=www.president.ee |access-date=29 June 2021}}</ref>
